description: Search the interests that already exist, so a curiosity can join a topic rather than splinter it. Pass query to filter by substring; omit it to see the first page. Call this BEFORE propose_interest and reuse an id whenever one genuinely fits — two labels for the same thing split the people who care about it into two topics that never meet. Returns labels only; it reveals nothing about who holds them.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

query.description: Optional substring to filter labels by.

name: list_interests
title: List Existing Topics
